# Vendored dans-core

Plain-file vendored copy of `dans-core` (https://github.com/Daniel-Sinkin/dans-core).

Source: v0.2.0-2-gfadfbe9 (commit fadfbe9)

Header-only. Consumed directly as the `dans::core` INTERFACE target defined in the
top-level CMakeLists.txt. Not fetched, not a git submodule, not consumed through
its own CMakeLists.txt.
